q03.

**DB — `store/db/postgres/postgres.go`**

The struct is `postgres.DB`, holding just a `*sql.DB` handle and the profile:

```16:19:store/db/postgres/postgres.go
type DB struct {
	db      *sql.DB
	profile *profile.Profile
}
```

It satisfies the `store.Driver` interface via pointer receiver methods — `GetDB`, `Close`, `IsInitialized`, `GetDatabaseSize` in this file, plus the per-entity methods spread across sibling files in the same package (`memo.go`, `user.go`, `attachment.go`, and so on). The constructor `NewDB` returns it as a `store.Driver`, and it's wired up in `store/db/db.go` under the `"postgres"` case.

Note that each dialect package uses the same struct name `DB` (`sqlite.DB`, `mysql.DB`, `postgres.DB`), so the package qualifier is what distinguishes them.
